company.description: Higgsfield provides AI-powered tools for creating and editing images and videos. Its platform includes AI video generation, image generation and editing, cinematic scene creation, camera controls, visual effects, video upscaling, lip-syncing, and character creation. It also offers tools such as Marketing Studio, Cinema Studio, Canvas, Supercomputer, and integrations with various AI models for creative workflows.
